verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gateway-level per-tool enable/disable controls and 'credential-managed' calls, plus bearer keys for the directory API. Nothing documents issuing API credentials with scopes or least-privilege limits for an agent. Per-tool access control is an adjacent control, not scoped credential issuance, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
